title: Heavy Rain & Waterlogging Farm Advisory
content: Provide immediate field drainage trenches at lower boundaries to evacuate excess surface water. Suspend all fertilizer broadcasts, pesticide sprays, and irrigation. Post-rain, apply a light foliar spray of 1% Urea + 0.5% Zinc Sulphate to restore root activity once water recedes.

title: Dry Spell & Drought Farm Advisory
content: Apply organic straw or plastic mulch around crop rows to conserve soil moisture. Execute protective micro-irrigation at critical stages (flowering and seed formation). Spray 1% Potassium Nitrate (13-0-45) to induce drought tolerance and reduce leaf transpiration.
source: IMD Agromet & ICAR Drought Management Division

title: Heat Wave & High Temperature Farm Advisory
content: Provide light frequent irrigations during evening hours to maintain root zone cool temperature. Irrigate nursery beds daily. Apply kaolin clay foliar spray (5%) to reflect excess sunlight and protect fruits from sunscald.

title: Cold Wave & Frost Protection Advisory
content: Apply light evening irrigation to raise soil temperature overnight. Create smoke fires on western boundaries using dry farm waste to create a protective thermal blanket over crops. Spray 0.1% Dilute Sulphuric Acid or soluble Potassium.

title: High Humidity & Fungal Disease Risk Advisory
content: High humidity combined with warm temperatures creates optimal conditions for fungal diseases (Downy Mildew, Blast, Blight, Powdery Mildew). Ensure proper plant spacing and prunings for canopy aeration. Apply preventive copper or sulfur sprays.

title: Low Humidity & Dry Air Advisory
content: Accelerates evapotranspiration causing rapid soil drying and flower drop. Irrigate fields regularly and maintain organic mulching to prevent soil surface crusting and blossom desiccating.

title: Strong Winds & Storm Lodging Protection
content: Provide mechanical staking support for tall crops like sugarcane, banana, and papaya to prevent wind lodging. Postpone tall chemical spraying. Earthing up soil around crop base strengthens anchorage against squalls.
